state: Manual photo-relative reconstruction, not a botanical or facade survey; source-only private study.

controls.status: Measured source roof component; photo corner correspondence manual.
Current architectural base estimate, +/-1.5 m; partly obscured by foliage, not an independent surveyed datum.
Manual visible leaf-mass envelope, +/-40 px and deeper individual sprays; not palm fronds.
Visible bottom of canes; original root/soil placement remains estimated and slope-dependent.

pixel_method.depth_basis: Same field of view and mapped foreground bed is 4-10 m closer than the facade, at roughly 45-60 m camera distance. Camera GPS provides approximate XY only; no surveyed camera pose.
pixel_method.interpretation: The photo supports an overlapping 5-7 m typical leaf mass with taller individual tips, not the old 1.8-3.6 m sparse cane recipe. The large interval includes unknown camera pitch, occlusion, estimated body base and depth.

v2_rationale: Keep the leaf-mass tips around the reconstructed lowest facade cornice (~15.33 m), with irregular tips to 16.4 m. Derive each stem height from its exact existing root so the rising rear bed does not create an unqualified second-story canopy. Absolute bounds and cornice height remain architectural estimates.

architect_corroboration.form: Dense long narrow blades in arching/drooping sprays obscure most canes on the west side of the garage. Separate tall palms extend above this mass; exact species unverified.

camera_metadata_limits: Phone EXIF altitude 56.59 m and magnetic direction 285 degrees are inconsistent/unqualified for local IGN height and visible building bearing. Neither is used as geometry datum. No pixel colors or photographic textures are copied to the model.
preservation: Root poses, soil, retaining walls, house core, two palms, portal reserve and all unrelated native/ground data unchanged.
local_reference_path_note: Ignored reference files are evidence locations only. Production reads only foreground-properties.json and derives original root positions from the retained deterministic recipe; no cache/photo dependency.
source_review_scope: Luna bounded private source/camera PASS only; no native or whole-scene acceptance.
density_revision: Fourteen irregular arching sprays and twenty-four narrow closed blades per spray. V3 changes density only from V2; V1 uniform stem heights are superseded by the world canopy envelope.
